lines.12: Bilkul sahi—2 aur 3 ka sum 5 aur product 6 check karke aapne correct factors banaye. 6x + 9 ka factorisation kariye.
lines.13: Sahi, Arjun—dono terms se 3 common factor nikaal kar 3(2x + 3) likha. x² − 7x + 12 ka factorisation kariye.

judged2.verdict: The lesson jumped around too much, got stuck repeating the same zero-waste question, and the teacher ignored Tara's confusion to rush into new topics, so it didn't feel like a coherent chat.
